# Glossary {#sec-glossary .unnumbered}

Bilingual, because most readers will work across both languages and because the Indonesian technical vocabulary is not always settled.

| English | Bahasa Indonesia | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Backscatter | Hamburan balik | Fraction of a radar pulse returned to the sensor |
| Band | Band, saluran | One measurement layer within an image |
| Cloud masking | Pemulihan awan, masking awan | Removing cloud contaminated pixels before analysis |
| Composite | Komposit | One image assembled from many acquisitions |
| Confusion matrix | Matriks kekeliruan | Table of predicted against actual classes |
| Data leakage | Kebocoran data | A predictor that secretly encodes the label |
| Digital elevation model | Model elevasi digital | Raster of ground or surface height |
| Embedding | Embedding | Learned vector representation of a place |
| Feature stack | Feature stack, tumpukan fitur | Multi band image of all predictors |
| Ground truth | Data lapangan, kebenaran lapangan | Independently verified reference observation |
| Low shot learning | Pembelajaran low shot | Training from very few labelled examples |
| Mixed pixel | Piksel campuran | Pixel containing more than one land cover |
| Omission error | Galat omisi | Real class the map failed to record |
| Commission error | Galat komisi | Class the map recorded that is not there |
| Overall accuracy | Akurasi keseluruhan | Share of validation points classified correctly |
| Polarisation | Polarisasi | Orientation of a transmitted and received radar wave |
| Producer accuracy | Akurasi produsen | Complement of omission error |
| Pseudo absence | Pseudo-absence | Unoccupied sample used as a negative label |
| Reducer | Reducer | Function collapsing many values into fewer |
| Reflectance | Reflektansi | Fraction of incoming energy returned by a surface |
| Resolution, spatial | Resolusi spasial | Ground size of one pixel |
| Resolution, temporal | Resolusi temporal | Revisit interval |
| Resolution, spectral | Resolusi spektral | Number and width of bands |
| Resolution, radiometric | Resolusi radiometrik | Sensitivity of the detector, in bits |
| Segmentation | Segmentasi | Grouping pixels into coherent objects |
| Speckle | Speckle, bintik | Grainy multiplicative noise inherent to radar |
| Spectral signature | Tanda tangan spektral | Reflectance as a function of wavelength |
| Stratified sampling | Sampling terstratifikasi | Sampling that guarantees representation per class |
| Supervised classification | Klasifikasi terbimbing | Classification learned from labelled examples |
| Texture (GLCM) | Tekstur (GLCM) | Local pattern of pixel to pixel variation |
| Training data | Data latih | Labelled examples used to fit a model |
| User accuracy | Akurasi pengguna | Complement of commission error |
| Validation data | Data validasi | Held out labelled examples used to score a model |

: Terms used throughout this book {.striped}

## Institutional and policy terms

| Abbreviation | Full form | Relevance |
|---|---|---|
| FOLU | Forestry and Other Land Use | Sector covered by Indonesia's net sink target |
| GMW | Global Mangrove Watch | Reference mangrove extent product |
| MRV | Monitoring, Reporting and Verification | Required for any carbon claim |
| NBCS | Nature Based Climate Solution | Category mangrove work falls under |
| NDC | Nationally Determined Contribution | National climate commitment under Paris |
| VCM | Voluntary Carbon Market | Where blue carbon credits are traded |
